verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI features are user-invoked: the cmd-j AI palette, saved custom prompts, and chat with filtered notes. Nothing in the evidence shows user-configurable automations, triggers, or schedules that run on their own. Kindle sync, background transcription, and daily-note creation are fixed built-in behaviors, and the Zapier connection, API, and deep links are external workarounds or developer building blocks rather than the product's own automation capability.
